scope: Existing whole-building replacement/upgrade, not an additional building or a color-only update. The earlier package already had three materials. Approval concerns the frozen early-period exterior approximation and its exchange files, not publication authority or physical manufacture.

view_findings.previews/front.png: The true entrance and three red curved canopies face the -X atrium axis. The red-column second-storey gallery wraps around the -X/-Y corner; the narrow-window segment near the hall is distinct. The low semicircular service projection now meets its display base. The green roof rises toward the hall and remains separate from the metal roof and raised PV.
view_findings.previews/rear.png: The two office window groups and recessed second-storey balcony, middle rear stair/arch, broad tapered ventilation tower, and separate rainwater collector/exterior stairs are differentiated. Rear openings are source-bound approximations rather than a copied front facade.
view_findings.previews/elevation.png: The entrance portal is not blocked by the silver corner screen. The three red curved canopies have distinct heights. Silver corner louvers, wooden upper entrance louvers and adjoining red-column gallery retain separate roles; approximate rail/slat counts are not survey measurements.
view_findings.previews/top.png: Office/atrium versus auditorium plan registration is unmirrored. Curved planted skin, underlying hall double-pitch metal roof and one static raised PV pose are three distinct systems. The shortened PV rear tip clears the broad tower; its rotation-axis ends no longer show gray patches piercing the PV skin.
view_findings.previews/left_oblique.png: The hall boat balcony has an opaque wall above a narrow lower window band and curved hanging ribs. The outer hall side, red rainwater stair, third slender tower and low service bay are visible as separate elements. Background buildings and standalone landscape boat are excluded.
view_findings.qa/entry-detail.png: Same-mesh interior/entrance view was inspected after the earlier exterior-only dark view was replaced. It supplements—not substitutes for—the actual STL empty-space rays and gallery geometry checks.
view_findings.qa/roof-detail.png: Same-mesh detail shows the three roof systems, grouped plant bands/access steps, three gray-capped ventilation towers and independent red/yellow wind frame. This is a simplified static equipment representation, not a mechanically operable or measured fabrication model.

resolved_draft_errors: Corrected entrance/pitched-garden registration without mirroring the entire 1F/3F plan or arbitrarily moving the rear arch and hall tower.
Added third-storey office volume, recessed rear balcony, source-based boat wall/ribs and the third slender ventilation tower.
Kept green garden roof, hall metal roof and floating PV separate; removed the tower/PV intersection and support-axis surface intrusion.
Added the true ground-floor curved service-bay outline without repeating it at every storey, and closed its accidental gap above the display base.

Reviewer explicitly withdrew the earlier exclusive -X-only red-column-gallery reading: body.jpg together with photos06/85 establishes an L-shaped return along part of -Y. The corrected final model was re-viewed, rather than retaining the erroneous instruction.

Column/slat heads were trimmed below the roof; three entry canopies now differ in height/span. Interior same-mesh inspection also identified two rooftop support feet protruding below the atrium roof; these were raised into their actual supporting roof skin rather than hidden in the render.
builder_validation_evidence_inspected: Final STL-bound strict lib3mf load/material edit-save/read, Blender actual vertex/material edit-save/reopen, saved-scene front render byte match, and isolated four-core/five-PNG nine-file byte reconstruction were read and exact-hash bound. Reviewer did not independently repeat the Blender editing experiments or the full 715-layer erosion run.
dates_and_sources: GBC completed rear photo nested EXIF records 2011-08-03 without a timezone. The 2013 blog date is publication, not an independently established camera date. Body/blog images lacking capture EXIF are not assigned a capture date.

The 2016 forum 3F diagram and 2017-modified 1F file cross-check plan relationships; their digital dates do not date photography or construction. This is a compatible early-2011–2013 exterior approximation, not a 2026 equipment survey.

No independent roof-floor plan was obtained. Real roof photographs, the full hall section and the 1F/3F plans were used together; scale-model photographs and neighboring buildings were excluded as as-built evidence. The unavailable repository PDF and denied/login routes were not used.
limits: No surveyed axes, certified scale, exact window/PV-cell/plant counts, or full as-built BIM. Relative -X/+X/-Y/+Y coordinates are a model registration convention, not a surveyed compass claim.

Fine rooftop fittings, hidden junctions and the upper transition over the low semicircular service bay remain approximate; the 3F rectangular plan was not replaced by an invented repeated curved facade.

Rooms and auditorium interiors are simplified solids. The central atrium and visible galleries remain open. Hidden basement, landscaping, neighboring buildings and the detached boat sculpture are omitted; the bottom slab is a display closure, not site terrain.
PV and wind machinery are fixed in one photograph-bound pose, with simplified visible supports. Opaque glazing is a color proxy. STL has no color or transparency.

715 global slices have valid contours, but 576 layers contain 4620 sub-0.8mm erosion islands. Nominal PV grid0.275mm, wind blades0.55mm and rails0.65mm remain disclosed. Supports, rescaling or manufacturing-specific changes may be needed; no minimum-wall certification, slicer guarantee, load test or physical print.
Raw topology and vertex-link verification does not prove absence of every geometric self-intersection. Rendered details are unchanged-mesh views, not cutaway reconstructions.
Private original images/PDFs stay outside the public package; this review grants no permission to redistribute them. It does not authorize main-repository edits or publication.
package_closure: Await actual final ZIP; artifact-level PASS does not by itself verify a later package or published snapshot.
